History and Development of the Company
Hamco
Ventures Limited (“Hamco”) were incorporated on February 7, 2024 under
the laws of the BVI with limited liability and has no material operations of its own. The Company conducts all its operations
in Hong Kong through its wholly-owned operating subsidiary, Hamco Creek Asia Development Company Limited (“Hamco Creek”),
incorporated in Hong Kong on March 1, 2024.
Hamco
Creek is a dynamic and innovative franchise development company specializing in the food & beverages industry with its headquarter
located in Hong Kong. We offer tailored consultant solutions to both emerging restaurant brands who are seeking to franchise a
business for the first time and established franchisors who are looking to improve its operation, IT system, online/offline marketing
Etc. We also provide services to assist clients to analysis market condition, perform feasibility study, market entry, competitor

We
presently offer our services to clients in Hong Kong and intend to expand the distribution of our services into other countries

B.
Business Overview
We
are a franchise development consultant company specializing in the food & beverages industry. We offer tailored consultant
solutions to both emerging restaurant brands who are seeking to franchise a business for the first time and established franchisors
who are looking to improve its operation, IT system, online/offline marketing Etc. We also provide services to assist clients
to analysis market condition, perform feasibility study, market entry, competitor research and due diligence on franchise opportunities.
During
the current financial year, we expanded our strategic business scope to address the growing technological needs of our
clients by launching specialized advisory and implementation services for Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) rollup .
Under this expanded offering, we assist clients with the strategic planning, integration, and scaling of AI technologies designed
to enhance operational efficiency, automate customer service workflows, and optimize data-driven decision-making within their
businesses.
We
presently offer our services to clients in Hong Kong and intend to expand the distribution of our services into other location
as opportunities permit.
Plan
of Operations
Over the course of the next 12 months, we plan
to spend a substantial portion of our effort on executing the following key operational objectives :
1.
Client Engagement,
Market Acquisition, and AI Service Monetization: We plan to implement targeted marketing campaigns, industry networking
initiatives, and strategic alliances to accelerate new client acquisition. A primary focus will be scaling our newly introduced
Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) rollout consultancy services, driving adoption among both existing franchise clients
and new enterprises seeking digital transformation solutions;
2.
Geographic Expansion
and Market Penetration: We intend to leverage comprehensive market research, competitor profiling, and feasibility studies
to identify high-growth international markets. Our efforts will be dedicated to developing and executing structured market-entry
strategies to expand our geographic footprint outside of Hong Kong as commercial opportunities permit; and
3.
Human Capital
Development and Technical Talent Acquisition: We are committed to scaling our internal capabilities by investing in advanced
professional development, specialized training modules, and technical certification programs for our existing team members.
Furthermore, we intend to aggressively recruit top-tier talent across critical domains, specifically targeting franchise development
experts and AI/technology implementation specialists to support our expanded service vertical.
Distribution
Methods of Our Services
We
currently market, sell, and distribute our professional consulting and technology implementation services from our operational
base in Hong Kong. To maximize market penetration, effectively deliver our specialized solutions, and scale our new Artificial
Intelligence (“AI”) rollout verticals, we utilize a multi-channel distribution strategy comprised of the following primary
methods:
●
Direct
Client Engagement: We interact directly with prospective and existing clients through
structured in-person consultations, secure virtual platforms, and dedicated digital communication
networks. This direct model allows us to deliver highly customized franchise frameworks
and tailored AI integration roadmaps while maintaining high service responsiveness.
●
Strategic
Alliances and Corporate Partnerships: We actively collaborate with key food and beverage
(F&B) industry associations, professional enterprise networks, and complementary
technology service providers. These alliances allow us to cross-promote our capabilities,
extend our market reach, and embed our consulting solutions into broader industry ecosystems.
●
Structured
Referral Ecosystems: We leverage an organic growth model by incentivizing strategic
partners, shareholders, executive officers, and employees to refer new business opportunities
to the Company. Referral fees payable by us to any referring party are determined on
an arm’s-length, case-by-case negotiated basis. This program allows us to acquire new
clients cost-effectively through established, high-trust networks.
Competitive
Business Conditions and the Issuer’s Competitive Position
The
franchise development and business consultancy industries are highly competitive, fragmented, and rapidly evolving. We operate
within a dynamic landscape alongside numerous local, regional, and global consulting firms. Many of our current and potential
competitors possess significantly greater financial, marketing, technical, personnel, and operational resources than we do, and
command established brand recognition globally or within the specific regional markets we intend to enter.
We
have not commissioned independent market research to quantify the exact number of franchise development firms operating within
Hong Kong that offer overlapping service portfolios. However, the Company distinguishes itself from traditional competitors through
its flexible, highly personalized engagement models, deep sector-specific expertise in the food and beverage (F&B) industry,
and its agility in integrating emerging technologies into legacy operational systems.
We
believe our competitive position is sustained by our ability to continuously adapt to market trends, deliver high-value advisory
services, and address the shifting technological needs of our clients. Specifically, the Company differentiates itself through
the following core competencies:
●
Established
Local Footprint and Comprehensive Service Suite: The Company maintains a solid client
base in Hong Kong, providing end-to-end consulting services across all phases of enterprise
growth. Our foundational solutions span franchise architecture, marketing and sales orchestration,
operational workflow optimization, compliance advisory, international market-entry modeling,
and specialized software selection. By bundling these comprehensive services at competitive
prices, we offer a cohesive value proposition that traditional boutique agencies cannot
match.
●
Technological
Differentiation through AI Integration: Unlike conventional franchise consultants,
we have aggressively expanded our capabilities to include specialized advisory and implementation
services for Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) rollouts. Our ability to bridge
the gap between traditional F&B operational workflows and advanced digital capabilities—such
as automated customer service systems and data-driven predictive inventory tools—allows
us to capture market share from tech-deficient competitors.
●
Global
Vision and Cross-Border Brand Scaling: With a forward-looking perspective on brand
internationalization, we specialize in unlocking the latent value of Asian and Hong Kong-based
brands on the global stage. Our robust market research capabilities enable us to identify
emerging cross-border consumer trends and execute structural market-entry strategies.
We actively leverage our regional strategic partnerships and alliances to mitigate the
risks of international expansion for our clients, creating sustainable long-term value.

Risks
Related to Our Business and Industry
We
are a newly formed company with limited operating history. An investment in our securities is highly risky and could result in
a complete loss of your investment if we are unsuccessful in our business plan.
Our
Company was incorporated on February 7, 2024. We have limited operating history upon which an evaluation of our future prospects
can be made. Based upon current plans, we expect to incur operating losses in future periods as we incur significant expenses
associated with operation and expansion. Further, there are no assurances that we will be successful in realizing revenues or
in achieving or sustaining positive cash flow at any time in the future. Any such failure could result in the possible closure
of our business or force us to seek additional capital through loans or additional sales of our equity securities to continue
business operations, which would dilute the value of any shares you purchase.
If
our business plan is not successful, we may not be able to continue operations as a going concern and our shareholders may lose
their entire investment in us.
As
discussed in the notes to this annual report, as of June 30, 2026, we had $437,451 of cash. If we fail to raise sufficient capital,
we will have to explore other financing activities to provide us with liquidity and capital resources, we need to meet our working

Risks
Related to Our New Business Initiatives and Service Offerings
Our
newly launched specialized advisory and implementation services for Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) rollup may fail
to meet client operational expectations, which could harm our reputation and financial condition.
We
have expanded our business scope to offer specialized advisory and implementation services for AI rollup, helping clients with
strategic planning, integration, and scaling of AI technologies to enhance operational efficiency, automate customer service workflows,
and optimize data-driven decision-making. The commercial success of this expansion is highly uncertain. If the AI tools we recommend
or implement fail to deliver measurable productivity gains, cause disruptions to our clients’ legacy systems, or provide
inaccurate automated outputs in customer service workflows, clients may terminate their engagements, demand refunds, or bring
breach-of-contract claims against us. Any failure to successfully execute these sophisticated integration projects could damage
our brand, lead to significant client churn, and prevent us from recovering the capital and resource investments dedicated to
this initiative.
Risks
Related to Our Dependence on Third Parties
Our
AI rollup advisory and implementation services are heavily dependent on third-party technologies and underlying models over which
we have no operational control.
Our
implementation framework involves selecting, combining, and rolling up third-party AI software applications, application programming
interfaces (APIs), and foundational machine learning models to solve our clients' technological needs. Because we do not own or
develop the underlying AI architectures, our service offerings are highly vulnerable to the performance, availability, and commercial
terms of these external technology vendors. Sudden modifications to vendor pricing structures, unexpected API deprecations, service
outages, or changes to usage policies could immediately break or degrade the automated workflows we have integrated for our clients.
If our core AI software suppliers discontinue support for their systems or lose their market-leading positions, our rollup frameworks
may become technologically obsolete, requiring us to incur substantial costs to re-engineer solutions for our clients.

related to competition.

of our very limited operating history, our management has not yet obtained market research, conducted by independent and qualified
